channel.title: RISK L.L.C. — Visa & Immigration News
channel.description: Latest US, Canada and UK visa and immigration updates, checked on official government sources.

item.title: DV-2027 green card lottery: registration still not open (October 2026 update)
item.description: As of October 11, 2026 the State Department has not opened DV-2027 registration. The December 2025 pause on DV visa issuance was lifted on August 28, 2026 by court order in Medani v. Trump, and further court dates are set for October 14–15.

item.title: UK Student visa: money you must show rises from 30 November 2026
item.description: Under HC 584, UK Student visa applicants must show £1,570 a month in London and £1,203 a month outside London for applications made on or after 30 November 2026.

item.title: Explainer: how a Canada work permit works for applicants from Uzbekistan
item.description: Canada has two kinds of work permits, employer-specific and open. Most applicants from Uzbekistan need a job offer, pay CAD 155 plus CAD 85 biometrics, and can later move to PR and citizenship.
